sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A tree native to eastern Java and the Lesser Sunda Islands. The taxonomic sources consulted do not establish a reliable adult height.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The terminal leaflets are broadly transverse, about 4.5–9 × 5–13 cm. Flowers are about 2.5–3.5 × 2–3 cm; the 5.5–10 cm pod is constricted between its purple seeds. This distinguishes it from E. tahitensis, which has red seeds.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: The references consulted do not document safe food use or a particular toxicity.
